title.narrative: REACH - IMS, Media partnerships for Accountability and Trust

description.narrative: The overall objective of the project is to contribute to freedom of expression and independent, pluralistic media as pillars of democratic development, fostering accountability and dialogue between authorities, civil society and the population in Eastern Neighbourhood Countries. The outcomes include increased capacity of media partners to produce and distribute data-driven and reliable content, to equip media actors to sustain operations in crisis environments and finally to support media partners in influencing media-related laws and policies through alliances.
